tiers.req: Rune system unlocked through the quest line and the free quest runeword slotted (top-left slots).
PRE x6 runeword active: +20 Drop Quantity, +20% offline gains, +200 attack, +2 portal kills. The 6 Premium Runes cost 150 + 250 + 350 + 500 + 700 + 900 = 2,850 gems.
TYR + SUR + VEX + LUM: +50% EXP, +300 attack, +5% offline gains.
DOT + WIR + YUR + SKO: +100 mining and woodcutting power, +40 multiloot. Needs Act 1 Hard for YUR.
APEX + SIRC + WER: +10% crit chance, +60% crit damage, +5 Drop Quantity. Needs Act 1 Hard for WER.
FAL + FAL + TES + WAR: +50% gold, +400 HP, +10 Drop Quantity. Needs Act 3 for TES and WAR.
WAR + YUR + GRO + MIN + TYR + FAL: x1.5 attack, +10% offline gains, +20 Drop Quantity.

tables.title: Rune rules
rows: The whole recipe must sit in the same rune circle. A runeword replaces its runes' individual bonuses with a larger one.
Three identical runes can merge into the next tier. Tier 1: 3 runes is a 50% chance and 6 is 100%. Tiers 2 and 3: 3 runes is 33% and 9 is 100%. A failed merge returns one rune.
Farm the first rune of a family and merge upward to the one you need.
Buy more sockets as you become able to make runewords.

GOR + MU + HAS gives +200 HP, +1 portal kill and +10% all EXP. It is the cheapest runeword (all tier-1 runes): the Go to Act 2 Town quest gives all three runes, and spare GOR drops in Act 3 zones 1 to 4.
Players report that random ascension reaches legendary runes faster than saving for the guaranteed merge.
You start with 6 sockets and 14 inventory slots; the gem shop sells 9 more sockets.
The order of tiers 3 to 7 is by where the runes drop, not from a guide.
Each +1 portal kill makes a kill count once more toward opening a zone portal.
RYS also drops from Act 3 Palm trees, as well as Act 2 Ironwood trees, and WOM also from Act 3 Sunstone ore, as well as Act 2 Thorium ore.
